description: This source file defines extension methods for XGraphics objects to facilitate accessibility features such as text and graphic modes within PDF rendering, specifically for the XGraphicsPdfRenderer class.

classes.name: PdfRendererExtensions
classes.description: A static helper class providing extension methods to control rendering modes associated with XGraphics objects for accessibility purposes.

methods.name: BeginTextMode
methods.description: Activates Text mode for the provided XGraphics object, initializing necessary rendering components.

methods.name: BeginGraphicMode
methods.description: Activates Graphic mode for the provided XGraphics object for enhanced accessibility rendering.

methods.name: IsInTextMode
methods.description: Checks whether the given XGraphics is currently in Text mode.
